rows.basis: The release credits the December 2021 quarter to 'cloud data center demand for our high capacity nearline products'. That is cloud demand in words, with no AI line or amount.

Seller-side signal: the data center markets were about 75% of fiscal 2025 revenue (nearline to cloud and enterprise customers, plus VIA). That is a market share, not an AI share, so no AI amount is attributed.

Seller-side signal: the MD&A gives Data Center at 80% of fiscal 2026 revenue (about $9.8bn of $12.195bn), up from 75%, and the release cites 'robust cloud data center demand'. This is a market share, not an AI share, so no AI amount is attributed.
The CEO expects cloud data center momentum 'continuing in 2027'. No amount is given and there is no AI-specific figure.
